task_description: Fix 6 critical issues with TrustMark GAS web app deployment: (1) mobile unable to open due to GAS HtmlService stripping script src tags, (2) mini map not showing (related to #1), (3) need logo position controls, (4) VRF code should be center-right small gold, (5) payment QR not showing (related to #1), (6) camera not working on laptop. Root cause of issues 1/2/5 is that GAS strips static script tags on mobile - fix by using dynamic script loading.

verification.summary: No build system or test framework. Verified structurally: no static script tags in head, loadScripts/initApp functions present, logo position select added, VRF color #D4A841 at fontSize*0.55, getUserMedia camera modal added, HTML braces balanced.
